title: Board Pointer Bridge Env Guard
description: Canvas renders but pointer interaction fails when the window pointer bridge is disabled because process.env.VITEST or other env leaks into Vite/Playwright browser runs. Tighten boardRendererUsesWindowPointerCaptureBridge to use compile-time import.meta.env.MODE===test (with vitest config mode:test) and drop fragile process.env.VITEST checks.
summary: Pointer bridge used `process.env.VITEST === "true"` to stay off under Vitest; that env leaks into Playwright’s Vite webServer (`env: { ...process.env }`), disabling the window capture bridge in real Chrome while document-capture listeners still win—canvas paints but gestures never reach WASM. Replaced with `import.meta.env.MODE === "test"` via shared `boardSourceRunsAsVitestUnitBundle` (WASM init + bridge) and set `test.mode: "test"` in board vitest.config. Ran `bun nx run @elements/board:test --skip-nx-cache` (exit 0).
